args: command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 || { export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; }; url="$(sed -n 's/^DATABASE_URL=//p' ./.env | tail -n1)"; url="${url%\"}"; url="${url#\"}"; [ -n "$url" ] || { echo 'DATABASE_URL no encontrada en ./.env' >&2; exit 1; }; exec npx -y @henkey/postgres-mcp-server --connection-string "$url"
